component.name: Omaverse
component.summary: Outline scripture, annotate the original languages, and diagram sentences

description.p: Omaverse is a study desk for working through a book of scripture. It keeps three kinds of document, each in a plain file you can read without it.

ul.li: Outlines: ordinary Markdown, where the heading depth carries the structure. The outline pane on the left is navigation; the text on the right is one continuous document, foldable section by section.
Interlinears: a passage in Hebrew or Greek, one word at a time, with your own gloss, lemma, parsing and notes written underneath each word.
Diagrams: a Reed-Kellogg canvas. The passage's words wait in a bank along the bottom; drag them onto the standard strokes, which hold together where they meet and move as one.

description.p: Everything is Markdown or TOML on disk, written atomically, and never overwritten if something else changed the file first. Any of the three can be printed to PDF.
First release: outlines, interlinears, sentence diagrams, and PDF export.
